title: Write result direct-read prototype
impact: Tested a narrow writer-path cleanup that decoded `resqlite_write_result` fields directly from the native pointer instead of creating a typed-list plus `ByteData` view per `executeWrite()` call. Rejected: the focused `write_result_direct_read.dart` harness did not reproduce a stable win across order-flipped passes (pair 1 mixed/small, pair 2 broadly candidate-slower, pair 3 mixed/neutral). Runtime prototype preserved at `archive/exp-214`; the focused harness is retained for future writer-result floor checks.
